answer: Mesh nodes verify physical uniqueness using time-domain reflectometry along dedicated copper cabling, mapping impedance pulses like sap flowing through a branching vine. Each participant must physically anchor discrete signal lines to an antenna tower at its zenith. An adversary cannot virtualize transmission lines on shared hardware; deploying extra identities demands purchasing discrete physical transceivers and running separate coaxial lines. This scarce capital procurement cost per node bounds per-device voting weight to physical port count, preventing Sybil spoofing.
